summary: Small empty bush car park off the Mt Coot-tha road, nothing built nearby.
reasons: Flat on the car park surface

drivers.seclusion: Enclosed by dense bush; only a non-dwelling building 46 m away, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays opens straight off the road; no gate seen.
drivers.traffic: Quiet park road; car park is off the lane.
drivers.convention: Public visitor car park; empty in both images, so a van would be the only one.

flags: Steep around the pin: 11% mean grade, but the car park itself is about 1%
Possible night closure of the park road
sun_shade: Bush canopy shades the west and south edges; the middle is open to sun.

best_section.where: Small asphalt car park just north of the pin, off the bend in the road
